newsitem.title: USA: Fed approves Chinese bank branch in New York.
newsitem.headline: Fed approves Chinese bank branch in New York.

text.p: The Federal Reserve on Monday approved an application by China Construction Bank of Beijing to establish a representative office in New York.

China Construction Bank, wholly owned by the Chinese government, has assets of about $211 billion and is the third largest of four specialized banks in China. It has branches in London, Frankfurt, Seoul, Tokyo and Singapore.

The New York office's activities would be limited to general marketing, developing correspondent banking relationships and some loan solicitation. It would not solicit business from individuals or conduct any trading activities.
